episode_title: E.B. Moss has No Filter – about B2B content

real_qa.q: What percentage of B2B buyers are using generative AI in the buying process according to Forrester research?
real_qa.r: According to a Forrester research report that E.B. Moss cited in an article for ANA Magazine, approximately 94% of B2B buyers are using generative AI in the buying process. This statistic highlights how AI has leveled the playing field in B2B buying, since buyers can easily search online for information. The real differentiator for companies is how well they communicate their value proposition and what's in it for the buyer through effective storytelling and content creation.
real_qa.requete: Forrester B2B buyers generative AI percentage

real_qa.q: What does E.B. Moss say about synthetic voices and authenticity in B2B content marketing?
real_qa.r: E.B. Moss emphasizes that the human should always be in the loop when using synthetic voices. While synthetic voices generate some trust and engagement, human listeners can still detect them, and this detection can slip engagement metrics somewhat. She advocates that a human thumbprint should be visible or audible in content, and notes there have been studies showing that perceived trust and engagement with synthetic voices is not as strong as with authentic human voices, though synthetic audio is better than having no audio content at all.
real_qa.requete: synthetic voices authenticity B2B content trust

real_qa.q: What four different voices does E.B. Moss say companies must hear and respect in their messaging strategy?
real_qa.r: According to an article E.B. Moss shared on LinkedIn, the four voices companies must respect are: Voice of the Customer (VOC) for feedback; Voice of the Employee (VOE) for understanding what employees are going through; Voice of Process for understanding how business systems are actually performing; and Voice of Business representing what finance and leadership are concerned about. Incorporating all four of these voices into content strategy helps companies speak empathetically to all their constituents.
real_qa.requete: four voices VOC VOE company messaging strategy

real_qa.q: How does E.B. Moss recommend companies humanize B2B executives to build trust and engagement?
real_qa.r: E.B. Moss recommends disarming executives through personal touches like bad puns or unexpected elements, and highlighting personal stories or volunteer work that reveals the human side. She emphasizes that humanization doesn't require the CEO to always be the public face—sometimes a more personable brand director makes a better spokesperson. She also stresses media training for senior executives, noting that many lack feedback on their presentation styles. The goal is to let the human components of the company shine through across various channels suited to different team members' strengths.
real_qa.requete: humanize B2B executives brand trust storytelling

real_qa.q: What does E.B. Moss advise new entrants to the marketing and media industry to prioritize in their career development?
real_qa.r: E.B. Moss advises new professionals to embrace content and be present across all platforms, learn how to speak and write well, and maintain curiosity as algorithms and AI change. She emphasizes that while AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude can serve as launchpads, writers must learn to apply their own thumbprint and ensure content doesn't sound purely AI-generated. She also recommends getting mentored, interviewing many people, and keeping learning as the most important practice for long-term success in the industry.
real_qa.requete: advice new marketing media professionals career development

guest.titre: Senior Writer on the Global Marketing Team
guest.bio_context: E.B. Moss started her career as a cub reporter at a daily paper writing obituaries and wedding announcements, then worked as a radio copywriter and voiceover artist. She progressed through major media brands including E! Entertainment Television, Lifetime Television, Food Network, and Media Village, focusing on ad sales and marketing. She is currently a senior writer on Nielsen's global marketing team and hosts the podcast Insider Interviews; she also serves on the board of the Podcast Academy.

real_quote: Authenticity shines through, and people trust people who seem forthright, or brands that seem forthright, and who plant a stake in the ground for what they believe in.
